big_case.notes: Solicitor General petition defending Presidential Proclamation 10,888's suspension of asylum access at the southern border after the D.C. Circuit largely affirmed classwide relief against it; the Court granted plenary review on the proclamation's lawfulness and on whether 8 U.S.C. 1252(f)(1) bars the classwide relief. Nationwide immigration policy, presidential power against an express statutory right to apply, and a recurring remedial limit; 22 States as amici. Among the highest-stakes cert-stage matters of the Term, short only of a case with direct constitutional holdings at issue.
